name: A clip that answers somebody shows their message as it is read out
description: The viewer message the clip answers pops in over a blurred frame as the streamer reads it, drawn the way the chat showed it, and leaves when they finish; the hook stays on screen throughout.
when: the clip was cut from a stream recording and answers something a viewer said in the chat

then.prompt: If the clip answers a message from the chat, the streamer reads it out near the start: that message pops in over the video while they read it, and the hook stays on screen the whole time. If nobody asked, do not invent one: the clip runs on the hook alone.
